body:
Once we click to share links network variant, we should go to final editor, where we can change how it is rendered as SVG and download PNG and other formats so on as needed.

The share small icon should be shown only when links network card is hovered with mouse, or we click the card itself and that goes to the page of card which is mostly done for visuals configuration of specific links network image and sharing into social media.

At this page we should be able also to see math notation as per theory, numeric representation as N-ary number, and links notation representation, all of which should be editable, so we have ability to draw exactly any links network configuration and share it, but we start from one we clicked on.

So that is separate page dedicated to links network viewing, editing and sharing.

We should have as much configurations as possible.

For example for the links shape itself we should be able to configure angle at which link comes to another link.

The start of link shape, the end of link shape and so on.

So each and detail perfectly configurable.

Also colors and so on.

The background, if it is transparent, borders of card, style of them and so on.

Do we need card at all or just use plain black background and links shapes.

We also need to add experimental option to solve for lines collisions, so we draw link entering or comming away at specific angle, so we reduce overlapping between links shapes.
title: Add a share option for all links variants
